structured.answer: I'd open a securities account at פסגות and put 750 ₪ a month into the "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)" fund, which is the cheapest pair the page found. After 15 years that comes to about 179,889 ₪ "בכסף של היום", after fees and tax, and the page assumes 2% inflation a year and 7% return a year.

stuck.why: I typed 750 and the box says 750, but the slider label says 800. For a second I wasn't sure which one it used. The 135,000 ₪ deposited is 750 a month, so I went with that
The number never says 'inflation' next to it. I only found the 2% because I tapped a grey 'אינפלציה' button at the side, and it opened a popup
